summary: Scaling laws predicted that bigger language models would keep getting better, GPT-3 proved it, and AlphaFold 2 solved protein folding.
DALL-E turned words into pictures, GitHub Copilot started suggesting code, and the EU proposed its AI Act.
InstructGPT learned to follow instructions, Stable Diffusion opened image generation to all, and ChatGPT put AI chat in everyone's hands.
GPT-4, Claude and Gemini arrived, open models like Llama spread, and governments began writing rules for AI.
OpenAI's o1 began reasoning before answering, AI research won two Nobel Prizes, and the EU AI Act took effect.
DeepSeek-R1 shook the industry, coding agents moved into developers' terminals, and AI reached gold-medal level at the Math Olympiad.
GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 3.5 and Claude Opus 5 arrived, AI-written math proofs awaited review, and agents broke into real systems, even outside tests.
